title: errors.Is stops matching ErrNotFound
statement: Callers do `errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound)` and it comes back false for a missing key, from both Get and Delete. Fix the store so the sentinel survives, without losing the key name from the message. `go test ./...`.
notes: Needs the Go toolchain only. Two near-identical lines in one file have to change and a third, already correct one must not — Put already wraps with %w. Near-duplicate lines are exactly where an edit tool that matches on text rather than on a hash-anchored region applies the change to the wrong one, so this task is aimed at ADR-0006's failure mode.
